scripts.deps:graph:all: mkdir -p deps && depcruise src/app --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --output-type dot --collapse '^src/app/shared/ui/[^/]+' --prefix '../' | dot -T svg -o deps/dependency-graph-all.svg
scripts.deps:graph:modules: mkdir -p deps && depcruise src/app --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --output-type dot --collapse '^src/app/shared/ui/[^/]+' --focus '^src/app/modules/' --focus-depth 1 --prefix '../' | dot -T svg -o deps/dependency-graph-modules.svg
scripts.deps:graph:core: mkdir -p deps && depcruise src/app --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --output-type dot --collapse '^src/app/shared/ui/[^/]+' --focus '^src/app/core/' --focus-depth 1 --prefix '../' | dot -T svg -o deps/dependency-graph-core.svg

scripts.deps:graph:shared: mkdir -p deps && depcruise src/app --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --output-type dot --collapse '^src/app/shared/ui/[^/]+' --focus '^src/app/shared/' --focus-depth 1 --prefix '../' | dot -T svg -o deps/dependency-graph-shared.svg
scripts.format: prettier --write "src/**/*.{ts,html,css,json}" "scripts/**/*.mjs" ".github/**/*.{yml,yaml}" ".vscode/**/*.json" ".gemini/**/*.md" AGENTS.md "src/**/AGENTS.md" .dependency-cruiser.cjs package.json angular.json components.json tsconfig*.json README.md .prettierrc
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "src/**/*.{ts,html,css,json}" "scripts/**/*.mjs" ".github/**/*.{yml,yaml}" ".vscode/**/*.json" ".gemini/**/*.md" AGENTS.md "src/**/AGENTS.md" .dependency-cruiser.cjs package.json angular.json components.json tsconfig*.json README.md .prettierrc
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm test --no-watch && pnpm build
